Republic 01 the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, Wost Triangle, Quezon City http /tw•rw #.gov.ph 1 5 AUG 2017 DILG OPINION NO. 19 HON. LORNA S. ESPINA Mayor Mahayag, Zamboanga del Sur Dear Mayor Espina: This has reference to your letter dated 09 August 2017, which was forwarded to the Central Office by DILG-Region IX Director Paisal O. Abutazil for appropriate action, raising the following issues: 1. Whether or not the manner of serving the Order is in order considering that it was not facilitated by the DILG personnel; 2. Whether or not an Oath of Office will already suffice as a requirement for the assumption of the Acting Mayor or it still needs authority from the DILG? 3. Does the implementation of the suspension order covered by the 90-day period set by Section 62 of the Local Government Code which prohibits Orders of Preventive Suspension from the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, Sangguniang Panlungsod and Sangguniang Bayan to be implemented? Your aforesaid letter was prompted by the issuance ofGovernor Antonio H. Cerilles of an Order dated 04 August 2017 placing you under preventive suspension for a period of 6() days. Said Order was received by your good Office on 07 August 2017. In this regard, we deem it proper to answer first your third query. Section 62 (c) of Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 provides: Section 62. Notice of hearing. - xxx

(c) However, no investigation shall be held within ninety (90) days iinmediately prior to any local election, and no preventive suspension shall be imposed within the said period. If preventive suspension has been imposed prior to the 90-day period immediately preceding local election, it shall be deemed automatically lifted upon the start of aforesaid period. Based on the foregoing, no administrative investigation shall be conducted by the Office of the President, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the Sangguniang Panlungsod and the Sangguniang Bayan, in the exercise of their jurisdiction to take cognizance of administrative complaints against elective local officials within their respective disciplinary authorities, within 90 days prior to any election. No preventive suspension shall likewise be imposed during the same period and if one has earlier been imposed. the same shall be automatically lifted at the start Of the 90-day period. While postponement and/or suspension of the upcoming 23 October 2017 Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Elections has been proposed, the same remains pending before the House of Representatives and Senate up to this date. Such being the case, the aforequoted Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991, the calendår' of activities set forth under COMELEC Resolution No. 10177 and all other laws and issuances pertaining to the upcoming 23 October 2017 Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Elections are still applicable, unless and until the aforesaid legislative measures had been passed by Congress and approved by the President. Based on our computation, the 90-day period prior to the scheduled 23 October 2017 Synchronized Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Elections shall commence on 25 July 2017. Unless the legislative measures pending before Congress had been sooner passed and approved, starting on 25 July 2017 up to 22 October 2017, no preventive suspension shall be imposed upon local elective officials subject of administrative cases filed before the Office of the President, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, the Sangguniang Panlungsod and the Sanæguniang Bayan and if preventive suspension has been imposed prior to the 90-day period immediately preceding local election, it shall be deemed automatically lifted upon the start of aforesaid period. Byr the documents forwarded to the Central Office, the Order placing you poder preventive suspension was issued by Governor Cerilles on 04 August 2017, thus within the 90-day prohibited period under Section 62 (c) of the Local Government Code of 1991. Since the aforesaid Order contravenes Section62 if) of the Local Government Code of 1991, it could not be given force and effect.

Given the foregoing discussion, we find no more reason to answer your first and second queries. We hope to have guided you accordingly. 1.017 Copy furnished: DIR. PAISAL O.
